靠腰: (lit.) to cry from hunger (from Taiwanese 哭枵, Tai-lo pr. [khàu-iau])/(Tw) (slang) to whine; shut the hell up!; fuck!; damn!
靠走廊: next to the aisle/aisle (seat on aircraft)
靠走道: on the aisle (referring to seats on a plane etc)
靠近: to be close to/to approach; to draw near
靠边: to keep to the side/to pull over/move aside!
靠邊: to keep to the side/to pull over/move aside!
飠: "to eat" or "food" radical in Chinese characters (Kangxi radical 184)
魠: used in 土魠魚|土𱇏鱼[tu3 tuo1 yu2] and 𩵚魠魚|𬶂𱇏鱼[tu3 tuo1 yu2]
鱠: used in 鱠魚|鲙鱼[kuai4 yu2]/minced or diced fish (variant of 膾|脍[kuai4])
鵠: center or bull's eye of an archery target (old)/goal/target
鵠候: to respectfully await/to look forward to
鹠: used in 鵂鶹|鸺鹠[xiu1 liu2]
